issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Monospace from Directus
products.tagline: The governed API layer for every app, person, and agent
products.summaryZh: 面向每个应用、每个人和每个智能体的受治理 API 层
products.descriptionZh: Monospace 位于企业数据与其所有构建者之间。连接任意数据源，你的开发者、业务团队和 AI 代理即可获得实时读写访问权限。所有操作都遵循同一套细粒度权限模型，无需复制或迁移数据。你那些年代久远的数据库在设计时并未考虑 AI 或现代应用。Monospace 直接基于它们生成接口，保持原样，实时内省 schema 和查询，因此无需重建。
products.description: Monospace sits between enterprise data and everyone who builds on it. Connect any data source, and your developers, business teams, and AI agents get live, read-write access to it. All under the same granular permissions model, with no data copied or moved. Your oldest databases weren't built with AI or modern apps in mind. Monospace generates interfaces directly from them, as they are, introspecting the schema and queries in real time, so they don’t need to be rebuilt.

products.name: Yedric.ai
products.tagline: Let users control your SaaS with natural language
products.summaryZh: 让用户用自然语言控制你的 SaaS
products.descriptionZh: 你的用户不应该需要了解每个功能的位置。Yedric 为你的 SaaS 添加了一个可嵌入的 AI 代理，将自然语言请求转化为你的产品已经知道如何执行的操作。用户只需说出他们想要完成的事情，Yedric 就会处理交互。开发者无需构建和维护自己的代理体验，即可在 30 分钟内让现有产品具备 AI 原生能力。
products.description: Your users shouldn't have to learn where every feature lives. Yedric adds an embeddable AI agent to your SaaS that turns natural-language requests into actions your product already knows how to perform. Users simply say what they want done and Yedric handles the interaction. Instead of building and maintaining your own agent experience, developers can make their existing product AI-native in under 30 minutes.

products.name: Dots by OpenAI
products.tagline: Always on agents built to handle everything
products.summaryZh: 始终在线的代理，旨在处理一切事务
products.descriptionZh: ChatGPT 中的智能体始终以圆点形式呈现，由 GPT‑6 Astra 驱动。每个圆点都拥有自己的云计算机和浏览器，通过插件连接超过 4,000 款应用，并能全天候朝着你的目标推进。你可以在桌面端、网页端和移动端的 ChatGPT 中向你的圆点发消息或通话，也可以在 Slack 和 Teams 中给它发消息。它会从反馈中学习你的偏好，并将完成的工作交给你审阅。自定义规则、活动视图和自动审阅让你始终掌控全局。现正向 Pro 和 Business Premium 推出。
products.description: Dots are always on agents in ChatGPT, powered by GPT‑6 Astra. Each dot has its own cloud computer and browser, connects to over 4,000 apps through plugins, and can work toward your goals 24/7. Message or call your dot in ChatGPT on desktop, web, and mobile, or message it in Slack and Teams. It learns your preferences from feedback and brings you finished work to review. Custom Rules, Activity View, and auto review keep you in control. Rolling out now to Pro and Business Premium.

products.name: Omnia Agent
products.tagline: The AI Agent that does 95% of your GEO work
products.summaryZh: 完成你95% GEO工作的AI代理
products.descriptionZh: 每个品牌都需要在AI搜索中占有一席之地。现在，无需聘请GEO专家，你的品牌也能做到。Omnia Agent能找出竞争对手正在获胜的提示词，然后凭借为GEO打造的技能为你赢得这些提示词。它能接入你已在使用的工具，因此你批准的每一项操作都能直接上线，无需额外工作。
products.description: Every brand needs to show up in AI search. Now yours can, without hiring a GEO expert. Omnia Agent finds the prompts where your competitors are winning, then wins them for you with skills built for GEO. It plugs into the tools you already use, so every action you approve goes live with no extra work.

products.name: Polylane
products.tagline: AI agents that fix production before you wake up
products.summaryZh: 在你醒来之前，AI代理已修复生产问题
products.descriptionZh: 没有人应该随时待命。Polylane 连接你的代码、基础设施和可观测性数据，调查每一起事件，并提交包含修复的拉取请求。如果代码无法修复，你会得到根本原因和一项建议。
products.description: Nobody should be on call. Polylane connects your code, infra and observability data, investigates every incident and opens a pull request with the fix. If code can't fix it, you get the root cause and a recommendation.

products.name: DSH Desktop
products.tagline: Official app for DeepSeek’s open-source agent harness
products.summaryZh: DeepSeek 开源智能体框架的官方应用
products.descriptionZh: DeepSeek Harness Desktop 是 DeepSeek 开源 agent harness 的官方 Mac 和 Windows 应用。安装并登录后，即可在本地运行日常工作、编码和定时任务，并使用与 CLI 相同的插件系统。
products.description: DeepSeek Harness Desktop is the official Mac and Windows app for DeepSeek’s open-source agent harness. Install it, sign in, and run everyday work, coding, and scheduled tasks locally with the same plugin system as the CLI.

products.name: statusbar
products.tagline: a statusbar for any terminal
products.summaryZh: 适用于任何终端的状态栏
products.descriptionZh: 适用于任何终端的状态栏。
products.description: A status bar for any terminal.

products.name: Chat.sh
products.tagline: The help center I built after Intercom's search broke
products.summaryZh: 在Intercom搜索功能出故障后，我搭建的帮助中心
products.descriptionZh: 🎉 仅限发布日：使用优惠码 PHLAUNCH，任意终身套餐立减 200 美元（399 美元 → 199 美元，799 美元 → 599 美元）。截止 10 月 2 日凌晨 12 点（太平洋时间）。大多数帮助中心只给你一个子域名、一个关键词搜索和一张月度账单。chat.sh 不一样：🔍 AI 搜索，会写出答案并引用所用页面 📁 存放在你自己网站的文件夹中（yoursite.com/help）🤖 每个页面都以 markdown 格式提供给 ChatGPT、Claude 和 llms.txt 💸 一次付费，无需订阅 在 chat.sh/help 试用。聊天 messenger 和支持收件箱即将推出。
products.description: 🎉 Launch day only: $200 off any lifetime deal with code PHLAUNCH ($399 → $199, $799 → $599). Ends Oct 2, 12 AM PT. Most help centers give you a subdomain, a keyword search, and a monthly bill. chat.sh is different: 🔍 AI search that writes the answer and cites the pages it used 📁 Lives in a folder on your own site (yoursite.com/help) 🤖 Every page as markdown for ChatGPT, Claude, and llms.txt 💸 Pay once, no subscription Try it at chat.sh/help. Chat messenger and a support inbox are next.

products.name: Bracket
products.tagline: The memory layer for your business
products.summaryZh: 为你的业务提供记忆层
products.descriptionZh: Bracket 将你业务中已有的对话转化为持续更新的动态记忆。连接 Gmail、Slack、Figma 和 GitHub，或添加会议记录和转录文本。Bracket 会自动捕获需求、决策、范围、交付物、截止日期和变更。随后，你可以向 Bracket 询问任何已发生的事情，或利用完整上下文生成回复。无需再手动维护另一个工具。
products.description: Bracket turns the conversations already happening across your business into a living, continuously updated memory. Connect Gmail, Slack, Figma and GitHub, or add meeting notes and transcripts. Bracket automatically captures requirements, decisions, scope, deliverables, deadlines and changes as they happen. Then ask Bracket about anything that happened or generate replies using the full context. No more manually keeping another tool up to date.

products.name: Starlie
products.tagline: A fast, native Jira client for Mac
products.summaryZh: 一款快速、原生的 Mac 版 Jira 客户端
products.descriptionZh: Starlie 为你日常的 Jira 工作而生：查找问题、了解进展、更新状态、发表评论、在面板上移动问题，然后继续工作。流畅的看板拖放、快速筛选、JQL 自动补全、自定义字段、快速查看、提醒，以及用 ⌘K 打开最近的问题。同时支持 Jira Cloud 和自托管 Jira。设计上注重隐私，不含分析或跟踪。可在 Claude Code 或 Codex 中打开编码任务，并附带问题上下文和你的本地项目。
products.description: Starlie is for the Jira work you do every day: find an issue, see what’s going on, update it, leave a comment, move it across the board, and get back to work. Smooth Kanban drag and drop, quick filters, JQL autocomplete, custom fields, Quick Look, reminders, and ⌘K for recent issues. Works with Jira Cloud and self-hosted Jira too. Private by design, with no analytics or tracking. Open coding tasks in Claude Code or Codex with issue context and your local project attached.

products.name: Buddy Drop
products.tagline: Drop the files, get a live URL in seconds
products.summaryZh: 拖入文件，几秒内获得实时链接
products.descriptionZh: Buddy Drop 让你在几秒内将网站或应用上线。只需拖入文件夹、ZIP 或文件，即可从一系列免费域名中选择，或连接你自己的域名。其余一切交给 Buddy 处理，从托管和部署到预览和版本管理。无需注册。
products.description: Buddy Drop puts your site or app online in seconds. Just drop your folder, ZIP, or files and choose from a range of free domains or connect your own. Buddy takes care of the rest, from hosting and deployment to previews and versioning. No signup required.

products.name: Helo
products.tagline: An independent email API from former Postmark folks
products.summaryZh: 来自前Postmark团队的独立邮件API
products.descriptionZh: Helo 是一款为开发者和平台打造的邮件 API，支持代表客户发送邮件。在不良发件人拖累送达率之前将其拦截，让客户使用自己的域名发送邮件，并按租户分别维护统计数据、退订信息和凭证。它还涵盖基础功能：REST API 和 SMTP、主流语言的 SDK、事务性邮件与群发邮件基础设施相互独立，以及按用量计费，每封邮件低至 $0.00035——所有功能均已包含。
products.description: Helo is an email API built for developers and platforms that send on behalf of their customers. Contain bad senders before they drag down deliverability, let customers send from their own domains, and keep stats, unsubscribes, and credentials separate per tenant. It also covers the fundamentals: REST API and SMTP, SDKs in popular languages, separate transactional and broadcast infrastructure, and usage-based pricing starting at just $0.00035 per email—all features included.

products.name: Vitra.ai
products.tagline: Agentic content platform to create and localize content
products.summaryZh: 代理式内容平台，用于创建和本地化内容
products.descriptionZh: 别再切换工具了！Vitra.ai Universe 一个平台就能完成 12 款工具的工作：用 100 多种语言创建、翻译和个性化视频、图像、文档和音频。通过唇同步进行配音，翻译来自 Figma、Canva 和 Adobe 的设计，并让每个创意适配各种尺寸。Vitra Flow 中的 AI 智能体端到端运行你的工作流，由你的团队审批。品牌工具包、翻译记忆库和风格指南让每一份输出都符合品牌规范。自主内容运营的未来已来。免费开始，无需信用卡。
products.description: Stop switching tools! Vitra.ai Universe does the work of 12 tools in one place: create, translate and personalize video, images, docs and audio in 100+ languages. Dub with lip-sync, translate designs from Figma, Canva and Adobe, and adapt every creative to every size. AI agents in Vitra Flow run your workflows end to end, & your team approves. Brand kits, translation memory, & style guides keep every output on-brand. The future of Autonomous Content Operations is here Start free, no credit card.

products.name: NotchMind
products.tagline: Put your MacBook notch to work: music, files, timers & more
products.summaryZh: 让你的MacBook刘海发挥作用：音乐、文件、计时器等
products.descriptionZh: NotchMind 将你的 MacBook 刘海变成一个集音乐、文件、剪贴板历史、计时器、下载和 28 项日常工具于一体的空间。原生 macOS 应用，一次买断。
products.description: NotchMind turns your MacBook notch into a home for music, files, clipboard history, timers, downloads and 28 everyday tools. Native macOS app, one-time purchase.

products.name: JevGPT
products.tagline: A chatbot built on a model that can't write
products.summaryZh: 一个基于无法写作的模型构建的聊天机器人
products.descriptionZh: 多年来，我们一直用为撰写文本而构建的大型语言模型来做选择。JevGPT 则投桃报李：一款聊天应用，其中 TypeSafe 的 Jev——一个为做选择而构建的模型——每次通过一道多选题逐词写出每一条回复。它行得通吗？勉强可以。开源。
products.description: For years we've used LLMs built to write text to make choices. JevGPT returns the favor: a chat app where TypeSafe's Jev, a model built to make choices, writes every reply one multiple-choice word at a time. Does it work? Sort of. Open source.

products.name: Basedash chat dashboard preview
products.tagline: One prompt. A whole dashboard, live in your chat.
products.summaryZh: 一句提示，整个仪表盘就在你的聊天中实时呈现。
products.descriptionZh: Basedash chat 现在只需一条提示词就能构建完整的仪表板——KPI、图表、表格、筛选器和标签页——并在对话中实时预览。输入“一个包含销售管道、赢单率和按销售代表划分收入的销售仪表板”，它就会直接生成在对话中，随时可用。更改日期筛选器，切换标签页，满意后将其作为完整仪表板打开。销售、支持、产品、财务和运营团队都可以从一句话开始。一条提示词。整个仪表板，实时呈现在你的聊天中。
products.description: Basedash chat now builds whole dashboards from one prompt — KPIs, charts, tables, filters, and tabs — and previews them live right in the conversation. Ask for "a sales dashboard with pipeline, win rate, and revenue by rep" and it lands inline, ready to use. Change the date filter, switch tabs, then open it as a full dashboard when it looks right. Sales, support, product, finance, and ops can all start from a sentence. One prompt. A whole dashboard, live in your chat.

products.name: Clarity
products.tagline: Mute the room, keep the speaker, in real time
products.summaryZh: 实时静音房间，保留扬声器
products.descriptionZh: 面向语音代理的实时语音增强与目标说话人提取。Clarity-1 在实时通话中剔除背景噪声和其他人的说话声，让你的代理只听到来电者。音频到达即流式处理。可在我们的网站上试听前后对比。
products.description: Real-time speech enhancement and target speaker extraction for voice agents. Clarity-1 strips out background noise and other people talking on a live call, so your agent hears only the caller. Streams as audio arrives. Hear the before/after on our site.

products.name: Firetower
products.tagline: Run coding agents on your own servers, from anywhere
products.summaryZh: 在你自己的服务器上运行编码代理，随时随地。
products.descriptionZh: 在你掌控的基础设施上运行 Claude Code 和 Codex 等编码代理，并通过桌面端或移动端进行管理。它开源、可自托管，使用 Rust 构建。
products.description: Run coding agents like Claude Code and Codex on infrastructure you control and manage them from desktop or mobile. It's open source, self-hostable, and built in Rust.

products.name: America.gov
products.tagline: Whatever you need from government, start here.
products.summaryZh: 无论你需要政府提供什么，从这里开始。
products.descriptionZh: America.gov 是获取美国政府信息最简单、最快捷的方式。无需在各部门网站间搜寻，只需用平实语言提问，即可获得清晰答案。该平台由美国国家设计工作室与总务管理局共同打造，将各联邦机构汇聚于一处。现提供英语、法语和西班牙语版本。即将推出：直接在聊天中申请、注册并跟踪进度。
products.description: America.gov is the simplest, fastest way to get information from the U.S. government. Instead of hunting across agency websites, just ask a question in plain language and get a clear answer. Built by the National Design Studio with the General Services Administration, it brings every federal agency together in one place. Available in English, French, and Spanish. Coming next: apply, enroll, and track progress right in chat.

products.name: Phare C1®
products.tagline: A smoke alarm that detects fire, not toast.
products.summaryZh: 能探测火灾而非烤面包的烟雾报警器。
products.descriptionZh: Phare C1 是一款烟雾报警器，只在真正紧急情况下发出警报，其他时候保持安静。其多传感器阵列能及早、准确地探测火灾和一氧化碳，减少误报，并依托可不断学习改进的探测算法，让你的家随着时间推移更加安全。它保留了 Nest Protect（已停产）备受喜爱的功能，如预警、夜灯和应用内提醒，并新增了空气质量监测和入侵检测等功能。
products.description: Phare C1 is a smoke alarm that sounds for actual emergencies and nothing else. Its multi-sensor array spots fire and CO early and accurately, reduces false alarms, and is backed by detection algorithms that learn and improve to make your home even safer over time. It keeps much-loved features from the Nest Protect (RIP) like early warnings, a night light, and in-app alerts, and adds new ones like air quality monitoring and intruder detection.
